channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Mapping the Iran war’s strikes on Gulf energy – and what comes next for oil
item.description: US energy companies have reaped billions from rising oil price, but their assets in the region remain at risk.

item.title: Turkiye, Somalia forces free cargo vessel hijacked by pirates
item.description: Somali authorities say 14 pirates were killed in the 10-day operation to free a Cameroon-flagged cargo vessel.

item.title: Iran war live: Tehran in no rush to open Hormuz; West Bank attacks continue
item.description: Deputy foreign minister says Iranian forces have 'full oversight' of movements in the strait.

item.title: Ukrainian nuclear power plant without external power for over a week
item.description: This is the 27th time since Russia invaded Ukraine that Zaporizhzhia plant has had to rely on emergency diesel supplies.

item.title: Gaza runs out of cancer medicines, as Israeli strikes continue
item.description: Officials at Gaza’s Al-Aqsa Martyrs Hospital say cancer medicines have completely run out, as Israeli strikes continue.

item.title: Algeria wildfire death toll expected to rise as survivors say nothing left
item.description: Algeria says at least 12 people have been killed in wildfires sweeping the northeast, with the toll expected to rise.

item.title: Somali piracy surges as the impact of the US-Iran war ripples outwards
item.description: Two ships were seized within four days last week raising to at least 13 the number attacked since January.

item.title: Deadly strike on Kyiv warehouse prompts evacuations
item.description: Ukraine correspondent Dan Johnson reports from Kyiv after the deadly strike, which authorities said killed more than 30 people.

item.title: BBC tracks one week of Israeli settler violence in occupied West Bank
item.description: The BBC's Lucy Williamson reports on settler attacks on Palestinians, which have been observed over the last week alone.
